title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1121 | 飞船抵水星、神鸟飞一万公里、会发电的牙刷
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🚀 飞船 Bepi 飞行八年，今天终于抵达水星！
🐦 小鸟菲尔飞了一万零九百公里，从英国到西伯利亚再飞回来！
🪥 新型牙刷不用电池，刷毛弯曲就能发电，帮你打跑蛀牙细菌！

📖 Word of the day: migrate（迁徙）

🎮 小挑战：今天把单词 migrate 教给一个人，再讲讲小鸟菲尔飞了一万零九百公里的故事！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🚀 After eight years in space, the spacecraft Bepi arrives at Mercury today!
🐦 A little bird named Phil flew ten thousand nine hundred kilometers from England to Siberia and back!
🪥 A new toothbrush needs no batteries — its bristles make electricity when they bend!

📖 Word of the day: migrate

🎮 Tiny challenge: teach the word migrate to one person today, and tell them about Phil the bird who flew ten thousand nine hundred kilometers!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. migrate（迁徙）
When animals migrate, they travel a very long way to a new home.
例：Phil migrated all the way to Siberia.（菲尔一路迁徙到了西伯利亚。）

2. bristle（刷毛）
A bristle is one of the little hairs on a toothbrush.
例：The bristles bend when you brush your teeth.（刷牙时刷毛会弯曲。）

3. spark（火花；电花）
A spark is a tiny flash of electricity.
例：The toothbrush makes a tiny spark when the bristles bend.（刷毛弯曲时，牙刷会产生一个小小的电花。）

4. wader（涉水鸟）
A wader is a bird with long legs that walks in shallow water.
例：Phil is a wader with long legs and a long beak.（菲尔是一只长腿长嘴的涉水鸟。）
